name: Comte de Mercy-Argenteau
source:
"Just put it on and come here already! This is all for the sake of Austria, for Antonia's sake!"

Born in Belgium.
Hobby: Working
Likes: Reaping the Fruit of One's Labors
Dislikes: Not Being Able to Concentrate on Work

The Austrian ambassador.
A person who looks older than his years because he is always worrying.
He has a serious personality and always loyally notices the fine points of his orders.
He is always scolding the protagonist and manipulating [url=/c50768]Marie Antoinette[/url].
